Title: Strict Read-Only Policy on SAP S21
Decision: Block all POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE calls to S21; treat as read-only discovery
Consequences: Zero risk to SAP landscape; all output generated as local files

Title: Isolated BW Migration Studio Module
Context: HanaMorph currently has CDS, CalcView, Bulk, and Replication studios
Decision: Create BW Migration Studio as a distinct module in BW_Migration_Studio without touching existing studios
Consequences: Zero regression risk to existing studios; clean modular delivery

Title: Target-Agnostic Canonical Metadata Model
Context: Multiple target modernization paths exist (Datasphere, BDC, BW Bridge)
Decision: Ingest BW metadata into a normalized canonical model before target transformation
Consequences: Enables flexible re-targeting without re-extracting source BW metadata

Title: Lightweight Local Persistence with SQLite
Context: Local developers need offline discovery and testing without requiring HANA Cloud
Decision: Implement local SQLite persistence using relational schema matching CAP/CDS models
Consequences: Fast local developer loop; 100% reproducible offline testing

Title: Modular CSN Payload Generation
Context: Datasphere requires CSN (Core Schema Notation) for space deployments
Decision: Generate modular JSON schemas for Tables, SQL Views, and Analytic Models conforming to SAP CSN v2.0
Consequences: Native interoperability with Datasphere CLI and Business Builder
